paraphrase: OPEN analyst generalization: nothing gives what it does not have. Whatever causes a perfection r in a thing has r (in act, formally or eminently: the abstract InAct). ST I q.4 a.2 co. says this of the effective cause of a thing's being (STMT-PERFECTIONS-OF-EFFECT-PREEXIST-IN-CAUSE); extending it to every cause of any perfection is the analyst's.
